key: Nothing like a battle on the water!
en: Nothing like a battle on the water!
ja: 水の上での　バトルは　最高だぜ!

key: And a loss on the water!
en: And a loss on the water!
ja: 水の上での　負けも　また　いいもんだ!
ああ　この湖が　恋しかったよ

key: You've come quite far out, haven't you?
en: You've come quite far out, haven't you?
ja: ずいぶん　遠くまで　来たもんだな

key: With that kind of attitude, you'll get into all sorts of trouble-- and out of it just fine.
en: With that kind of attitude, you'll get into all sorts of trouble-- and out of it just fine.
ja: その調子なら　あんたは　いろんな　やっかい事に　首を突っこんで--　そのたびに　うまく　切りぬけるんだろうな
